company_name: Buddy Innovations and Technologies Pvt Ltd

layout_patterns.marketing: Mode A Tetris Grid with generous padding (py-16 md:py-24), sticky header with blur, dynamic CTA sections, and full footer
layout_patterns.dashboard: Mode B High Density Grid with fixed or collapsible sidebar navigation, top header stat bar, tabbed sub-views, cardless and bordered data containers
layout_patterns.video_analysis: Split view: 60% high-frame-rate video player with skeleton pose overlay, speed gauge, angle controls; 40% AI diagnostic report card with tabs for Observations, Drills, and Shot/Delivery metrics

key_components.marketing_page: Hero with real cricket action hero image, AI feature badges, interactive report preview teaser, clear pricing in INR (Razorpay credits format), real player/coach workflow steps, blog listing, and company disclosure (Buddy Innovations and Technologies Pvt Ltd)
key_components.video_upload: Drag-and-drop zone with drag active states, video preview thumbnail, progress percentage bar, metadata inputs (batting/bowling, pitch type, player role), and analysis trigger button
key_components.analysis_report: Confidence score meter, frame breakdown slider, AI observations bulleted list with severity tags (High, Medium, Low), recommended drills with step-by-step videos/text, export PDF button, and MUST include explicit label 'EXAMPLE REPORT' when displaying demo data
key_components.ai_coach_chat: Chat interface with persistent sidebar history, quick prompt recommendations ('Analyze my backlift', 'In-swing bowling drills'), real-time streaming response effect, and code/bullet points formatting
key_components.training_planner: Interactive checklist grouped by day/week, target drills, completion progress tracker, and streak counters
key_components.academy_workspace: Data table with player roster, total uploaded videos, AI improvement index, drill assignment actions, and filter by age group/role
key_components.admin_control_center: Sidebar tabs for Users, Credit Balance & Razorpay Transactions, AI Processing Queue, System Logs, SEO Metadata Settings, and CMS Blog Manager
key_components.auth_forms: Unified glassmorphic modal or page for Login/Signup/Verify OTP with 6-digit OTP input boxes, auto-focus transition, and Resend Timer

instructions_to_main_agent.file_type_extension: All React components must be written in JavaScript (.js or .jsx files)
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, form fields, tab buttons, modal triggers, card actions) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="upload-video-button", data-testid="pricing-plan-pro-buy").
instructions_to_main_agent.fake_data_policy: NO fake testimonials or misleading statistical claims. Any sample reports displayed on public or demo pages MUST be visibly labeled with a clear badge reading 'EXAMPLE REPORT'.
instructions_to_main_agent.credit_payment_system: Pricing must explicitly showcase INR pricing models integrated with Razorpay credit top-ups (e.g., ₹499 for 10 Analysis Credits, ₹1,999 for 50 Credits).
instructions_to_main_agent.header_navigation: Navbar must never be 100% transparent when scrolled. Use glassmorphic dark background (bg-[#0B132B]/80 backdrop-blur-md) with visible nav links and high-contrast CTA button.
instructions_to_main_agent.hover_contrast_rule: Every hover state must explicitly define text color (e.g., hover:bg-teal-500 hover:text-slate-950) to ensure high contrast APCA compliance.
